div.div:
Scope discipline: PO suggestions only. Allocation, inter-store transfers and assortment planning are OUT.
Trust KPI for the pitch: buyer override rate falling over time. Suggest-never-execute is the design, not a limitation.
Why Python here (unlike ideas 01-04): sklearn / XGBoost have no Java equivalent worth fighting. It is one batch container writing to Postgres — it never joins the Spring service mesh.
